label: copy phase: echoed q input whose next output is v (q->v bigram recall), mid/late position
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost exclusively (98% of mass) on steps where the fed-back input is q. Strongest (top activations ~2.5-2.9) when the token being output next is v, i.e. original contained the bigram q v, and the q sits at original position >= 2-3; q v at positions 0-1 is mostly silent. Weak activations (<0.3 of max) also occur on copy-phase q inputs followed by other tokens (q, u, n, w, ...) and rarely on v inputs, which the predicate misses (~21% of mass, ~45% of activation count). Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, nor on the first occurrence of a token.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
